mentions.excerpt: Edelbridge Alpha sees the town hall rather than the substation.
Edelbridge Alpha counts 26 US data-center projects blocked in the first quarter of 2026, against 31 in all of 2025, with another 49 delayed and 166 facing some form of opposition.

sides.claim: The creator is also hearing that Bloom keeps some capacity available rather than fully committing years in advance, allowing it to serve desperate customers needing power immediately at significantly better economics, analogous to Nebius publicly…
